messages:
Grace: RCA published for 2026-06-10 regional failover incident: <https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2719|RCA: region failover -> cache fragmentation>. Short summary: during an automated region failover a subset of KV cache shards became fragmented leading to higher p95 and a short spike in 503s for ~8 minutes. Impact ~1.8% of requests. No customer data leaked.

Grace: Owners and immediate asks below. Please confirm ETA and blockers in-thread.

Owners / Actions:
- Add shard-rebalance smoothing to failover path and a post-failover compaction job (Victor) — spec + PR by 2026-06-17.
- Expose per-shard fragmentation metric and alert if fragmentation > 70% for 5m (Isha) — instrument + alert by 2026-06-14.
- Run a failover replay that includes inter-region network jitter and verify compaction behavior (eng-sre / Tom) — schedule & share artifacts by 2026-06-20.
- Draft short exec note for ops digest (Grace) — ready by EOD.

Victor: Taking the smoothing and compaction work. Will sketch design and include a canary plan. Noted we should be careful with compaction IO during peak.

Isha: Will add fragmentation metric and a dashboard panel. Propose alert with a 5m burn AND a 1m early-warning alert. Posting spec in #eng-infra today.

Tom: Eng-sre will run replay. Need traffic profile from Grace and target failure injection points. Scheduling for 06/19 09:00 PT, pending trace bundle.

ops-bot: Incident INC-36111 created and linked to RCA 2719; owners: Victor, Isha, Tom, Grace.

Grace: Uploaded replay traces and notes: <https://internal.redwood.com/replays/serve-20260610|replay bundle>. Includes inter-region jitter scenarios and expected success criteria.

Victor: PR opened: <https://git.redwood.com/infra/patches/1199|fix/failover-smoothing>. Adding tests and a small-scale canary.

Isha: Metric instrumentation merged to staging; linking snapshot: <https://mon.redwood.com/dashes/frag-metrics|staging snapshot>. Will promote after alert tuning.

Tom: Replay scheduled 06/19 09:00 PT. Will post perf traces and pass/fail criteria here after run.

Grace: Exec note draft: "On 2026-06-10 an automated regional failover caused KV cache fragmentation that briefly increased latency and error rates for a small subset of requests. No customer data was exposed. We've added failover smoothing, fragmentation monitoring, and a compaction plan; verification is underway." Thoughts?

Victor: LGTM.

Isha: +1.

Tom: Will report replay results.

Grace: Weekly checkpoint invites sent for 06/21 10:00 PT. Please update INC-36111 with PR links and canary results. I'll consolidate closure notes in this thread when actions are complete. :white_check_mark:

Victor: noted.

Isha: will post alert thresholds after review.

Tom: will attach traces after replay.
